messages:
jeff: Heads-up — we're greenlighting a new region (ap-southeast-2) for dedicated GPU capacity next quarter. Need a concise runbook for cloud account/project setup + VPC scaffold so infra team can bootstrap. Anyone have a minimal validated checklist we can use for handoff to SOC/Platform?

maria: I can draft it. Quick Q: are we doing a new AWS account per environment or one account with multiple VPCs?

sara: For Dedicated we usually create a new AWS account per customer/region axis. Keeps limits and billing clean. :+1:

maria: OK i'll assume new account + control-plane peering. Will include steps for organization unit placement and SCPs.

alan: Important: check GPU SKU availability + AZ coverage before account setup. AP-southeast-2 sometimes has limited p4/g5 stock. I can run a capacity check.

infra-bot: Task created: INFRA-3421 "ap-southeast-2 account & VPC bootstrap checklist" — assigned to maria.

maria: Draft checklist (high-level):
1) Organization & Account
   - Create AWS account under prod org OU. Record account ID, root contact, and billing alias.
   - Apply baseline SCPs (deny high-risk APIs, enforce CloudTrail, require MFA for root).
   - Create cross-account IAM role for platform-admin (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/RedwoodPlatformAdmin).
2) Identity & Keys
   - Create SSO/Okta group mappings: infra-admins, platform-ops, security-auditors.
   - Provision KMS key in region with key policy that allows key usage from control plane account.
3) Networking (VPC scaffold)
   - Allocate VPC CIDR: 10.200.0.0/16 (confirm no overlap with on-prem & existing regions).
   - Create 3 AZ subnets per AZ: public (10.200.X.0/24), private (10.200.Y.0/22) for compute, db/infra (10.200.Z.0/24).
   - Create Internet Gateway, NAT Gateways (high-availability), Route Tables, and explicit routes for peering and NAT.
   - Enable flow logs to central log account (s3/CloudWatch) and set retention 90d.
   - Add VPC endpoints: S3, ECR, STS, SSM, SecretsManager.
4) Security & Observability
   - Baseline Security Groups: allow SSH from bastion only, control-plane CIDR, health-check ports.
   - NACLs: keep default permissive but document expected NACLs.
   - Enable CloudTrail (all regions) to central logging account.
   - Enable VPC DNS hostnames & resolver rules for private zones.
5) Peering & Routing
   - Create VPC peering/transit gateway to control-plane VPC. Publish route table changes in terraform plan.
6) GPU Quota & AMIs
   - Request EC2 quotas for desired GPU SKUs (g5, p4d, etc) and desired vCPUs. Track request IDs.
   - Publish AMI list with preinstalled CUDA/container runtime (ami-xxx).
7) Infra provisioning & Terraform
   - Create terraform workspace named: region-ap-southeast-2-prod. Lock state in S3 bucket with DynamoDB lock in central infra account.
   - Run terraform plan then apply in a canary account (non-prod) first.
8) Post-provision validation
   - Validate subnets, routes, NGW health.
   - Launch small GPU spot and on-demand instances, run stress test job (30m) to validate drivers, nvidia-smi, container runtime.
   - Validate egress/ingress ACLs, endpoints, KMS decrypt from control plane.
9) Handoff
   - Create runbook page in Confluence with links: terraform state, account IDs, contact list, quota links, AMI IDs, and test results.
   - Schedule 30-min handoff with SOC + platform oncall.

sara: Love the structure. Add: a checklist item to enable Instance Metadata Service v2 and block IMDSv1 at account/launch template level.

maria: Good catch. Adding IMDSv2 enforcement.

alan: For validation — here's the short test script I use. Add to runbook:
```bash
# basic GPU smoke test
aws ec2 run-instances --image-id ami-XXX --instance-type g5.12xlarge --count 1 --subnet-id subnet-abc --security-group-ids sg-abc --iam-instance-profile Name=GPUNodeProfile
# after ssh
sudo docker run --gpus all --rm nvidia/cuda:12.1-base nvidia-smi
```

maria: Nice. Also include a Terraform snippet for VPC endpoints and tags (we require certain tags for cost/accounting).

maria: TF snippet: ```hcl
resource "aws_vpc" "region_vpc" {
  cidr_block = var.vpc_cidr
  tags = { Name = "rwd-${var.region}-vpc" Environment = var.env CostCenter = "infra" }
}
```

jeff: What about cost controls? We need budget alarms and shutdown protection for accidental large spot fleets.

devops-bot: Budget alert created: Budget-ap-southeast-2-DEV - threshold 30% of forecast.

maria: Add policies:
- Enable AWS Budgets with Slack alerts for >20% spend vs forecast.
- Apply tag-based IAM condition to prevent launching >X GPUs without platform-admin approval.

alan: Also include a capacity fallback plan: if desired GPUs unavailable, auto-route jobs to nearest region (ap-northeast-1) with model variant or smaller batch size. Add routing policy and cost delta in runbook.

sara: For peering, confirm Transit Gateway limits and explicit acceptance steps. We hit a soft limit last year and had to request increase.

maria: I'll add a pre-flight checklist: 
- Confirm TGW attachments available, request quota if needed.
- Create peering with control-plane, add routes in both sides, and run connectivity test (tshark/tcpdump) for health checks.

jeff: Timeline: can we get account + VPC scaffold ready in two weeks? Need to gate Dedicated capacity sales comms.

maria: Two weeks is tight but doable if quotas and GPU availability are confirmed today. Alan — can you run availability check by EOD?

alan: On it. Posting results here when done.

infra-bot: INFRA-3421 updated: "availability check pending" -> "in progress".

jeff: Thanks. Once alan confirms, maria — push the runbook to confluence and create the TF workspace. We'll do a short walkthrough before handing to SOC. :rocket:

maria: Will do. I'll ping the channel when the Confluence page is live.

alan: availability check: ap-southeast-2 supports g5 and p4d but p4d numbers limited; recommend initial fleet use g5. Sending quota links in DM.
